indicators.context: Default CyberStrikeAI console port, HTTPS with a self-signed certificate on 0.0.0.0 (config.example.yaml) CHYing-agent's dashboard binds 0.0.0.0:8080 with no login (yhy0/CHYing-agent).
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CyberStrikeAI source code

indicators.context: Marker the web terminal client types (echo __WSS_PROBE_7b3e__) into a target's ttyd, wetty, GoTTY or Kubernetes exec terminal to find the right protocol; it comes back in the terminal output and stays in shell history
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CHYing-agent source code

indicators.context: Exit-code marker appended to every command the agent types into a target's web terminal (printf '\n__WSS_EXIT_c1a4__%s\n' with the saved exit code); printed in the output and kept in shell history
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CHYing-agent source code

indicators.context: End-of-command delimiter (echo __WSS_CMD_END_9f7a__) appended to every command the agent types into a target's web terminal
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CHYing-agent source code

indicators.context: Shell variable in the wrapper appended to every web terminal command (; __chy_rc=$?; printf ...). Look for it in shell history and terminal session logs on the target
indicators.source: ThreatDefence review of the CHYing-agent source code
